items.title: Eli Lilly joins Huntington’s race on $725m LoQus23 takeover
items.summary: LoQus23 hopes to take LQT-23 to the clinic in the near future as the Huntington’s community awaits a disease-modifying therapy.

items.title: Horus Pharma and Epitech Group agree global adelmidrol deal
items.summary: Horus Pharma has entered into an exclusive global licensing agreement with Italian biopharmaceutical firm Epitech Group to develop and commercialise adelmidrol.

items.title: FDA approves Novo’s Sogroya for paediatric Turner syndrome
items.summary: The US FDA has approved Novo Nordisk’s once-weekly Sogroya injection to treat growth failure in patients aged 2.5 years and above with Turner syndrome.

items.title: Responding to the Most-Favored-Nation policy: a follow-up review
items.summary: In March 2026, GlobalData considered new launches by focusing on European markets in the ten months before and after the MFN executive order had been announced.

items.title: Preventative healthcare powers new wave of UK regulatory reform
items.summary: Speakers at the 2026 DIA-MHRA Global Summit talked of a healthcare system overhaul with preventative medicine at the core.
